messages:
alex: Hey folks — thinking of doing a LAN night next Friday? Who's in? :joystick: 
jamie: In if there's pizza. Also can we do some Steam co-op? Left 4 Dead 2, Deep Rock Galactic, or Overcooked? :pizza: :grin: 
maria: Friday works for me. Overcooked is chaotic fun. ; ) 
tony: I can bring a spare monitor and my Switch for Mario Kart. 
alex: Nice. Plan: start ~7pm, Redwood office common area. Bring laptops + cables. Tony — you bringing the Switch dock? 
tony: Yep dock + 2 pro controllers. I also have an extra HDMI cable and power strip. 
jamie: I can bring PS controller adapters if anyone wants to use DualShock/DS4 on PC. 
maria: Vote time: React with :one: for L4D2, :two: for Deep Rock Galactic, :three: for Overcooked, :four: for Mario Kart/Splatoon party. (or add suggestions) 
alex: Also need someone to handle sign-up for spots (we only have limited tables). @jamie can you make a simple Google Sheet? 
jamie: On it. Will post link in a sec. 
deploy-bot: Reminder: office event policy — please sign the visitor waiver at reception if you bring guests. 
alex: Good shout, thanks bot. 
maria: Can we get some background music? I can make a playlist. 
tony: Putting down an order for extra ethernet cables — prefer wired for L4D2. 
jamie: Link to sheet: https://docs.google.com/sheetsexample (please put your name + platform) 
alex: Awesome. If anyone wants to practice earlier during lunch this week I'm usually around 12:30-1:15. 
maria: Count me in for lunch practice on Wed. 
jamie: I'll bring a few spare controllers and snacks. 
alex: Perfect. Last logistics: anyone allergic to nuts? (so we avoid bringing cut-up bakery). 
tony: Not me. 
maria: allergic to peanuts — heads up. 
alex: Noted. I'll set up a Slack reminder Friday 5pm for setup crew. Thanks all — stoked! :raised_hands: 
jamie: hype :party-parrot: 
alex: (pinned the google sheet)
